mwp_consider_candidate_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = mwp_scoring_active
            var:mwp_scoring_active = yes
            has_variable = mwp_scoring_schema
            var:mwp_scoring_schema = 2
            has_variable = mwp_scoring_owner
            var:mwp_scoring_owner = this
            has_variable = mwp_generation
            has_variable = mwp_scoring_generation
            var:mwp_scoring_generation = var:mwp_generation
            exists = scope:mwp_candidate_owner
            scope:mwp_candidate_owner = this
            exists = scope:mwp_candidate_generation
            scope:mwp_candidate_generation = var:mwp_generation
            exists = scope:mwp_candidate_catalog_id
        }
        save_scope_as = mwp_player
        mwp_scoring_dispatch_candidate_effect = yes
    }
}
mwp_scoring_dispatch_candidate_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            scope:mwp_candidate_catalog_id = 1
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = {
                    has_variable = mwp_seen_1
                }
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_seen_1
                value = yes
            }
            change_variable = {
                name = mwp_scoring_seen_count
                add = 1
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    exists = scope:mwp_candidate_damage
                    exists = scope:mwp_candidate_toughness
                    exists = scope:mwp_candidate_pursuit
                    exists = scope:mwp_candidate_screen
                    exists = scope:mwp_candidate_siege
                    exists = scope:mwp_candidate_stack
                    scope:mwp_candidate_damage >= 0
                    scope:mwp_candidate_toughness >= 0
                    scope:mwp_candidate_pursuit >= 0
                    scope:mwp_candidate_screen >= 0
                    scope:mwp_candidate_siege >= 0
                    scope:mwp_candidate_stack > 0
                    scope:mwp_candidate_damage > 0
                    scope:mwp_candidate_toughness > 0
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_live_valid_1
                    value = yes
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_damage_1
                    value = scope:mwp_candidate_damage
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_d13_native_damage_1
                    value = scope:mwp_candidate_damage
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_toughness_1
                    value = scope:mwp_candidate_toughness
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_d13_native_toughness_1
                    value = scope:mwp_candidate_toughness
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_pursuit_1
                    value = scope:mwp_candidate_pursuit
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_screen_1
                    value = scope:mwp_candidate_screen
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_siege_1
                    value = scope:mwp_candidate_siege
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_stack_1
                    value = scope:mwp_candidate_stack
                }
                change_variable = {
                    name = mwp_damage_1
                    add = var:mwp_terrain_damage_1
                }
                change_variable = {
                    name = mwp_toughness_1
                    add = var:mwp_terrain_toughness_1
                }
                change_variable = {
                    name = mwp_pursuit_1
                    add = var:mwp_terrain_pursuit_1
                }
                change_variable = {
                    name = mwp_screen_1
                    add = var:mwp_terrain_screen_1
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_damage_1
                    value = {
                        value = var:mwp_damage_1
                        min = 0
                    }
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_toughness_1
                    value = {
                        value = var:mwp_toughness_1
                        min = 0
                    }
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_pursuit_1
                    value = {
                        value = var:mwp_pursuit_1
                        min = 0
                    }
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_screen_1
                    value = {
                        value = var:mwp_screen_1
                        min = 0
                    }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:mwp_candidate_damage > 0
                        scope:mwp_candidate_toughness > 0
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        name = mwp_metric_terrain_1
                        value = {
                            value = {
                                value = var:mwp_damage_1
                                multiply = var:mwp_toughness_1
                                pow = 0.5
                            }
                            divide = {
                                value = scope:mwp_candidate_damage
                                multiply = scope:mwp_candidate_toughness
                                pow = 0.5
                                min = 0.001
                            }
                            subtract = 1
                            multiply = 100
                        }
                    }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        can_create_maa = huscarl
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        name = mwp_create_1
                        value = yes
                    }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        var:mwp_metric_cost_1 > 0
                        OR = {
                            can_create_maa = huscarl
                            any_maa_regiment = {
                                is_maa_type = huscarl
                                is_personal_maa_regiment = yes
                                is_regular_maa_regiment = yes
                                can_upgrade_maa = yes
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        name = mwp_eligible_1
                        value = yes
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        name = mwp_score_1
                        value = 0
                    }
                    change_variable = {
                        name = mwp_scoring_eligible_count
                        add = 1
                    }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        var:mwp_metric_cost_1 > 0
                        OR = {
                            has_variable = mwp_eligible_1
                            any_maa_regiment = {
                                is_maa_type = huscarl
                                is_personal_maa_regiment = yes
                                is_regular_maa_regiment = yes
                                regiment_owner = scope:mwp_player
                            }
                            mwp_type_unlocked_1_trigger = yes
                            any_held_title = {
                                holder = scope:mwp_player
                                OR = {
                                    can_create_title_maa = huscarl
                                    any_owned_title_maa_regiment = {
                                        is_maa_type = huscarl
                                        is_regular_maa_regiment = yes
                                        is_title_maa_regiment = yes
                                        regiment_owner = scope:mwp_player
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        name = mwp_assessed_1
                        value = yes
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        name = mwp_assessed_score_1
                        value = 0
                    }
                    change_variable = {
                        name = mwp_scoring_assessed_count
                        add = 1
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            scope:mwp_candidate_catalog_id = 2
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = {
                    has_variable = mwp_seen_2
                }
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_seen_2
                value = yes
            }
            change_variable = {
                name = mwp_scoring_seen_count
                add = 1
            }
            if = {
                limit = {

                                    }

                    }

                    }

mwp_scoring_collect_own_regiment_effect = {
    save_scope_value_as = {
        name = mwp_scoring_regiment_troops
        value = maa_current_troops_count
    }
    scope:mwp_player = {
        change_variable = {
            name = mwp_own_maa
            add = scope:mwp_scoring_regiment_troops
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            scope:mwp_scoring_regiment_troops > 0
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                maa_size > 0
                maa_max_troops_count > 0
            }
            save_scope_value_as = {
                name = mwp_scoring_regiment_chunks
                value = {
                    value = maa_current_troops_count
                    multiply = maa_size
                    divide = maa_max_troops_count
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    is_maa_type = huscarl
                }
                scope:mwp_player = {
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            has_variable = mwp_live_valid_1
                        }
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                has_variable = mwp_live_collecting
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                name = mwp_observed_damage
                                value = scope:mwp_live_damage
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                name = mwp_observed_toughness
                                value = scope:mwp_live_toughness
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                name = mwp_observed_pursuit
                                value = scope:mwp_live_pursuit
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                name = mwp_observed_screen
                                value = scope:mwp_live_screen
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                name = mwp_observed_siege
                                value = scope:mwp_live_siege
                            }
                            change_variable = {
                                name = mwp_observed_damage
                                add = var:mwp_terrain_damage_1
                            }
                            change_variable = {
                                name = mwp_observed_toughness
                                add = var:mwp_terrain_toughness_1
                            }
                            change_variable = {
                                name = mwp_observed_pursuit
                                add = var:mwp_terrain_pursuit_1
                            }
                            change_variable = {
                                name = mwp_observed_screen
                                add = var:mwp_terrain_screen_1
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                name = mwp_observed_damage
                                value = {
                                    value = var:mwp_observed_damage
                                    min = 0
                                }
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                name = mwp_observed_toughness
                                value = {
                                    value = var:mwp_observed_toughness
                                    min = 0
                                }
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                name = mwp_observed_pursuit
                                value = {
                                    value = var:mwp_observed_pursuit
                                    min = 0
                                }
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                name = mwp_observed_screen
                                value = {
                                    value = var:mwp_observed_screen
                                    min = 0
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        else = {
                            set_variable = {
                                name = mwp_observed_damage
                                value = var:mwp_damage_1
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                name = mwp_observed_toughness
                                value = var:mwp_toughness_1
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                name = mwp_observed_pursuit
                                value = var:mwp_pursuit_1
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                name = mwp_observed_screen
                                value = var:mwp_screen_1
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                name = mwp_observed_siege
                                value = var:mwp_siege_1
                            }
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = mwp_own_qty_heavy_infantry
                            add = scope:mwp_scoring_regiment_chunks
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = mwp_own_chunks_1
                            add = scope:mwp_scoring_regiment_chunks
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = mwp_own_damage_heavy_infantry
                            add = {
                                value = scope:mwp_scoring_regiment_troops
                                multiply = var:mwp_observed_damage
                                divide = 1000
                            }
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = mwp_own_toughness
                            add = {
                                value = scope:mwp_scoring_regiment_troops
                                multiply = var:mwp_observed_toughness
                                divide = 1000
                            }
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = mwp_own_pursuit
                            add = {
                                value = scope:mwp_scoring_regiment_troops
                                multiply = var:mwp_observed_pursuit
                                divide = 1000
                            }
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = mwp_own_screen
                            add = {
                                value = scope:mwp_scoring_regiment_troops
                                multiply = var:mwp_observed_screen
                                divide = 1000
                            }
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = mwp_own_siege
                            add = {
                                value = scope:mwp_scoring_regiment_troops
                                multiply = var:mwp_observed_siege
                            }
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = mwp_own_siege_tier0
                            add = {
                                value = scope:mwp_scoring_regiment_troops
                                multiply = var:mwp_observed_siege
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    else = {
                        set_variable = {
                            name = mwp_scoring_coverage_complete
                            value = no
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = mwp_scoring_unknown_regiments
                            add = 1
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = {
                    is_maa_type = landsknecht
                }
                scope:mwp_player = {

    save_scope_value_as = {
        name = mwp_scoring_regiment_troops
        value = maa_current_troops_count
    }
    scope:mwp_player = {
        change_variable = {
            name = mwp_enemy_maa
            add = scope:mwp_scoring_regiment_troops
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            scope:mwp_scoring_regiment_troops > 0
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                maa_size > 0
                maa_max_troops_count > 0
            }
            save_scope_value_as = {
                name = mwp_scoring_regiment_chunks
                value = {
                    value = maa_current_troops_count
                    multiply = maa_size
                    divide = maa_max_troops_count
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    is_maa_type = huscarl
                }
                scope:mwp_player = {
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            has_variable = mwp_live_collecting
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            name = mwp_observed_damage
                            value = scope:mwp_live_damage
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            name = mwp_observed_toughness
                            value = scope:mwp_live_toughness
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            name = mwp_observed_pursuit
                            value = scope:mwp_live_pursuit
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            name = mwp_observed_screen

            remove_variable = mwp_counter_active_targets
        }
    }
    else = {
        mwp_d14_counter_variant_skirmishers_effect = yes
    }
}

                    value = {
                        value = var:mwp_own_counter_skirmishers
                        add = var:mwp_scoring_candidate_counter_skirmishers
                    }
                    multiply = 0.45
                    divide = {
                        value = var:mwp_enemy_qty_skirmishers
                        min = 0.001
                    }
                    max = 0.9
                }
            }
        }
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_scoring_ratio
        value = mwp_scoring_after_ratio_value
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_d13_full_gain
        value = {
            value = mwp_scoring_utility_value
            subtract = var:mwp_scoring_before_utility
            min = 0
        }
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_d13_counter_ratio
        value = {
            value = {
                value = 0
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        var:mwp_own_effective_damage > 0
                        var:mwp_own_toughness > 0
                    }
                    value = var:mwp_own_effective_damage
                    multiply = var:mwp_own_toughness
                    pow = 0.5
                }
            }
            divide = {
                value = var:mwp_scoring_after_enemy_damage
                multiply = var:mwp_enemy_toughness
                min = 0.001
                pow = 0.5
                min = 0.001
            }
        }
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_d13_counter_gain
        value = {
            value = var:mwp_d13_counter_ratio
            divide = {
                value = var:mwp_d13_counter_ratio
                add = 1
            }
            subtract = var:mwp_scoring_before_utility
            min = 0
            max = var:mwp_d13_full_gain
        }
    }
    change_variable = {
        name = mwp_metric_field_$ID$
        add = {
            value = var:mwp_d13_full_gain
            subtract = var:mwp_d13_counter_gain
            multiply = var:mwp_d13_candidate_factor
            add = var:mwp_d13_counter_gain
            multiply = 1000
            multiply = var:mwp_scoring_scenario_weight
        }
    }
    change_variable = {
        name = mwp_metric_coverage_$ID$
        add = {
            value = var:mwp_d13_candidate_factor
            multiply = var:mwp_scoring_scenario_weight
        }
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_metric_before_$ID$
        value = {
            value = var:mwp_metric_before_$ID$
            max = var:mwp_scoring_before_ratio
        }
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_metric_after_$ID$
        value = {
            value = var:mwp_metric_after_$ID$
            max = var:mwp_scoring_ratio
        }
    }
    change_variable = {
        name = mwp_metric_counter_$ID$
        add = {
            value = {
                value = var:mwp_enemy_effective_damage
                subtract = var:mwp_scoring_after_enemy_damage
                min = 0
                divide = {
                    value = var:mwp_enemy_effective_damage
                    min = 0.001
                }
                multiply = 100
            }
            multiply = var:mwp_scoring_scenario_weight
        }
    }
    change_variable = {
        name = mwp_metric_pursuit_$ID$
        add = {
            value = {
                value = var:mwp_stack_$ID$
                multiply = var:mwp_pursuit_$ID$
                divide = 1000
            }
            multiply = {
                value = var:mwp_enemy_toughness
                add = var:mwp_enemy_screen
                min = 1
            }
            divide = {
                value = var:mwp_own_pursuit
                add = {
                    value = var:mwp_enemy_toughness
                    add = var:mwp_enemy_screen
                    min = 1
                }
                min = 1
            }
            divide = {
                value = var:mwp_own_pursuit
                add = {
                    value = var:mwp_stack_$ID$
                    multiply = var:mwp_pursuit_$ID$
                    divide = 1000
                }
                add = {
                    value = var:mwp_enemy_toughness
                    add = var:mwp_enemy_screen
                    min = 1
                }
                min = 1
            }
            min = 0
            max = 0.25
            multiply = {
                value = var:mwp_scoring_ratio
                max = 1
            }
            multiply = 100
            multiply = var:mwp_scoring_scenario_weight
        }
    }
    change_variable = {
        name = mwp_metric_screen_$ID$
        add = {
            value = {
                value = var:mwp_stack_$ID$
                multiply = var:mwp_screen_$ID$
                divide = 1000
                multiply = var:mwp_enemy_pursuit
                divide = {
                    value = var:mwp_own_toughness
                    add = var:mwp_own_screen
                    min = 1
                }
                divide = {
                    value = var:mwp_own_toughness
                    add = var:mwp_own_screen
                    add = {
                        value = var:mwp_stack_$ID$
                        multiply = var:mwp_screen_$ID$
                        divide = 1000
                    }
                    min = 1
                }
                max = 0.25
                multiply = 100
            }
            multiply = var:mwp_scoring_scenario_weight
        }
    }

            subtract = 0.75
            divide = 0.6
            min = 0
            max = 1
            multiply = {
                value = var:mwp_scoring_before_ratio

                divide = 0.6
                min = 0
                max = 1
            }
            min = 0.05
        }
    }

        name = mwp_siege_access_sum
        add = {
            value = var:mwp_siege_profile_access
            multiply = var:mwp_scoring_scenario_weight
        }
    }

    mwp_scoring_own_counter_effect = yes
    mwp_scoring_enemy_counter_effect = yes
    mwp_d14_counter_present_variants_effect = yes

        value = mwp_scoring_utility_value

    if = {

mwp_scoring_publish_effect = {
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_siege_access
        value = {
            value = var:mwp_siege_access_sum
            divide = {
                value = var:mwp_scoring_evaluated_rivals
                min = 1
            }
            min = 0.05
            max = 1
        }
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_siege_average_days
        value = {
            value = mwp_scoring_siege_before_work_value
            divide = {
                value = var:mwp_war_fort_weight_sum
                min = 1
            }
        }
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_siege_urgency
        value = 1
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_scoring_score_sum
        value = 0
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_best_score
        value = 0
    }
    remove_variable = mwp_best_catalog_id

mwp_scoring_finish_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = mwp_scoring_active
            var:mwp_scoring_active = yes
            has_variable = mwp_scoring_schema
            var:mwp_scoring_schema = 2
            has_variable = mwp_scoring_owner
            var:mwp_scoring_owner = this
            has_variable = mwp_generation
            has_variable = mwp_scoring_generation
            var:mwp_scoring_generation = var:mwp_generation
            var:mwp_scoring_seen_count = 111
        }
        save_scope_as = mwp_player
        mwp_scoring_reset_own_effect = yes
        every_maa_regiment = {
            mwp_scoring_collect_own_regiment_effect = yes
        }
        save_scope_value_as = {
            name = mwp_scoring_strength
            value = current_military_strength
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_own_levy
            value = mwp_scoring_own_levy_value
        }
        change_variable = {
            name = mwp_own_toughness
            add = {
                value = var:mwp_own_levy
                divide = 100
            }
        }
        every_in_list = {
            variable = mwp_war_scoring_rivals
            save_scope_as = mwp_scoring_rival
            scope:mwp_player = {
                mwp_scoring_reset_enemy_effect = yes
            }
            every_maa_regiment = {
                mwp_scoring_collect_enemy_regiment_effect = yes
            }
            save_scope_value_as = {
                name = mwp_scoring_strength
                value = current_military_strength
            }
            scope:mwp_player = {
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_enemy_levy
                    value = mwp_scoring_enemy_levy_value
                }
                change_variable = {
                    name = mwp_enemy_toughness
                    add = {
                        value = var:mwp_enemy_levy
                        divide = 100
                    }
                }
                mwp_scoring_evaluate_rival_snapshot_effect = yes
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable = mwp_war_analysis_ready
                var:mwp_war_analysis_ready = yes
                var:mwp_scoring_price_normalized = yes
                var:mwp_scoring_enemy_stats_live = no
                var:mwp_scoring_stationing_included = no
                var:mwp_scoring_coverage_complete = yes
                var:mwp_war_scoring_rival_count > 0
                var:mwp_scoring_evaluated_rivals = var:mwp_war_scoring_rival_count
            }
            mwp_scoring_publish_effect = yes
        }
        remove_variable = mwp_scoring_active
    }
}
mwp_live_receive_fort_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = mwp_scoring_active
            var:mwp_scoring_active = yes
            has_variable = mwp_scoring_schema
            var:mwp_scoring_schema = 2
            has_variable = mwp_scoring_owner
            var:mwp_scoring_owner = this
            has_variable = mwp_generation
            has_variable = mwp_scoring_generation
            var:mwp_scoring_generation = var:mwp_generation
            exists = scope:mwp_live_fort
            scope:mwp_live_garrison >= 0
            scope:mwp_live_garrison_max >= scope:mwp_live_garrison
            is_target_in_variable_list = {
                name = mwp_enemy_cache_fort_samples
                target = scope:mwp_live_fort
            }
            NOT = {
                is_target_in_variable_list = {
                    name = mwp_live_forts_received
                    target = scope:mwp_live_fort
                }
            }
        }
        add_to_variable_list = {
            name = mwp_live_forts_received
            target = scope:mwp_live_fort
        }
        change_variable = {
            name = mwp_live_forts_seen
            add = 1
        }
        change_variable = {
            name = mwp_war_garrison_total
            add = scope:mwp_live_garrison
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_war_garrison_peak
            value = {
                value = var:mwp_war_garrison_peak
                min = scope:mwp_live_garrison_max
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:mwp_live_forts_seen = var:mwp_enemy_cache_fort_count
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_enemy_cache_forts_ready
                value = yes
            }
        }
    }
}

mwp_live_store_expansion_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = mwp_assessed_$CATALOG$
        }
        change_variable = {
            name = mwp_live_expansion_count
            add = 1
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:mwp_live_expansion_count = 1
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_extra_1001
                value = $CATALOG$
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_extra_tier_1001
                value = $TIER$
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_extra_regiment_1001
                value = scope:mwp_live_regiment
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_damage_1001
                value = var:mwp_observed_damage
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_d13_native_damage_1001
                value = scope:mwp_live_damage
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_toughness_1001
                value = var:mwp_observed_toughness
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_d13_native_toughness_1001
                value = scope:mwp_live_toughness
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_pursuit_1001
                value = var:mwp_observed_pursuit
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_screen_1001
                value = var:mwp_observed_screen
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_siege_1001
                value = var:mwp_observed_siege
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_stack_1001
                value = scope:mwp_live_stack
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_metric_cost_1001
                value = var:mwp_metric_cost_$CATALOG$
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    scope:mwp_live_damage > 0
                    scope:mwp_live_toughness > 0
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_metric_terrain_1001
                    value = {
                        value = {
                            value = var:mwp_observed_damage
                            multiply = var:mwp_observed_toughness
                            pow = 0.5
                        }
                        divide = {
                            value = scope:mwp_live_damage
                            multiply = scope:mwp_live_toughness
                            pow = 0.5
                            min = 0.001
                        }
                        subtract = 1
                        multiply = 100
                    }
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_variable = mwp_eligible_$CATALOG$
                    scope:mwp_live_regiment = {
                        can_upgrade_maa = yes
                    }
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_extra_actionable_1001
                    value = yes
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:mwp_live_expansion_count = 2
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_extra_1002
                value = $CATALOG$
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_extra_tier_1002
                value = $TIER$

mwp_live_queue_regiment_effect = {
    save_scope_as = mwp_live_regiment
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                maa_current_troops_count > 0
                AND = {
                    is_personal_maa_regiment = yes
                    is_regular_maa_regiment = yes
                    maa_size > 0
                    maa_max_troops_count > 0
                    regiment_owner = scope:mwp_player
                }
            }
        }
        scope:mwp_player = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = {
                        is_target_in_variable_list = {
                            name = mwp_live_regiments
                            target = scope:mwp_live_regiment
                        }
                    }
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = mwp_live_regiments
                    target = scope:mwp_live_regiment
                }
                change_variable = {
                    name = mwp_live_expected
                    add = 1
                }
                scope:mwp_live_regiment = {
                    save_scope_value_as = { name = mwp_inventory_levels value = maa_size }
                    save_scope_value_as = { name = mwp_inventory_capacity value = maa_max_troops_count }
                }
                change_variable = { name = mwp_live_expected_levels add = scope:mwp_inventory_levels }
                change_variable = { name = mwp_live_expected_capacity add = scope:mwp_inventory_capacity }
            }
        }
    }
}
mwp_live_start_effect = {
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_live_collecting
        value = yes
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_scoring_enemy_stats_live
        value = no
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_scoring_stationing_included
        value = yes
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_live_side
        value = 0
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_live_character
        value = this
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_live_weight
        value = 1
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_live_initial
        value = yes
    }
    clear_variable_list = mwp_live_rivals_done
    save_scope_as = mwp_player
    clear_variable_list = mwp_live_rivals_pending
    mwp_scoring_reset_own_effect = yes
    mwp_live_load_actor_effect = yes
}
mwp_live_load_actor_effect = {
    save_scope_as = mwp_player
    change_variable = {
        name = mwp_live_epoch
        add = 1
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_live_stage
        value = 1
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_live_expected
        value = 0
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_live_received_count
        value = 0
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_live_knight_prowess
        value = 0
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_live_knight_count
        value = 0
    }
    remove_variable = mwp_live_character_seen
    set_variable = { name = mwp_live_expected_levels value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = mwp_live_expected_capacity value = 0 }
    clear_variable_list = mwp_live_regiments
    clear_variable_list = mwp_live_received
    if = {
        limit = {
            var:mwp_live_side = 0
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_live_maa_before
            value = var:mwp_own_maa
        }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_live_maa_before
            value = var:mwp_enemy_maa
        }
    }
    var:mwp_live_character = {
        save_scope_value_as = {
            name = mwp_live_strength
            value = current_military_strength
        }
        scope:mwp_player = {
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_live_strength
                value = scope:mwp_live_strength
            }
        }
        every_maa_regiment = {
            mwp_live_queue_regiment_effect = yes
        }
        every_held_title = { every_controlled_title_maa_regiment = { mwp_live_queue_regiment_effect = yes } }
        every_army = {
            every_army_maa_regiment = {
                mwp_live_queue_regiment_effect = yes
            }
        }
        every_knight = {
            save_scope_value_as = {
                name = mwp_live_prowess
                value = prowess
            }
            scope:mwp_player = {
                change_variable = {
                    name = mwp_live_knight_prowess
                    add = scope:mwp_live_prowess
                }
                change_variable = {
                    name = mwp_live_knight_count
                    add = 1
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

mwp_live_receive_character_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = mwp_scoring_active
            var:mwp_scoring_active = yes
            has_variable = mwp_scoring_schema
            var:mwp_scoring_schema = 2
            has_variable = mwp_scoring_owner
            var:mwp_scoring_owner = this
            has_variable = mwp_generation
            has_variable = mwp_scoring_generation
            var:mwp_scoring_generation = var:mwp_generation
            var:mwp_scoring_seen_count = 111
            has_variable = mwp_live_collecting
            var:mwp_live_stage = 1
            scope:mwp_live_epoch = var:mwp_live_epoch
            scope:mwp_live_actor = var:mwp_live_character
            NOT = {
                has_variable = mwp_live_character_seen
            }
            scope:mwp_live_knight_effectiveness >= 0
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_live_character_seen
            value = yes
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_live_knight_effectiveness
            value = scope:mwp_live_knight_effectiveness
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_live_commander_observed
            value = scope:mwp_live_commander_advantage
        }
    }
}
mwp_live_finish_actor_effect = {
    # A final receipt can arrive before the periodic integrity poll.
    # Revalidate the complete actor set before committing its accumulated stats.
    if = { limit = {
is_ai = no
is_alive = yes
exists = scope:mwp_candidate_owner
scope:mwp_candidate_owner = this
exists = scope:mwp_candidate_generation
has_variable = mwp_generation
scope:mwp_candidate_generation = var:mwp_generation
has_variable = mwp_scoring_active
var:mwp_scoring_active = yes
has_variable = mwp_scoring_schema
var:mwp_scoring_schema = 2
has_variable = mwp_scoring_owner
var:mwp_scoring_owner = this
has_variable = mwp_scoring_generation
var:mwp_scoring_generation = var:mwp_generation
var:mwp_scoring_seen_count = 111
has_variable = mwp_live_collecting
var:mwp_live_collecting = yes
has_variable = mwp_live_stage
var:mwp_live_stage = 1
exists = scope:mwp_live_actor
has_variable = mwp_live_character
scope:mwp_live_actor = var:mwp_live_character
exists = scope:mwp_live_epoch
has_variable = mwp_live_epoch
scope:mwp_live_epoch = var:mwp_live_epoch
has_variable = mwp_live_character_seen
var:mwp_live_received_count = var:mwp_live_expected
    } mwp_live_verify_inventory_effect = yes }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = mwp_scoring_active
            var:mwp_scoring_active = yes
            has_variable = mwp_scoring_schema
            var:mwp_scoring_schema = 2
            has_variable = mwp_scoring_owner
            var:mwp_scoring_owner = this
            has_variable = mwp_generation
            has_variable = mwp_scoring_generation
            var:mwp_scoring_generation = var:mwp_generation
            var:mwp_scoring_seen_count = 111
            has_variable = mwp_live_collecting
            var:mwp_live_stage = 1
            scope:mwp_live_epoch = var:mwp_live_epoch
            scope:mwp_live_actor = var:mwp_live_character
            has_variable = mwp_live_character_seen
            var:mwp_live_received_count = var:mwp_live_expected
        }
        save_scope_as = mwp_player
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_live_stage
            value = 2
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:mwp_live_side = 0
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_live_actor_levy
                value = {
                    value = var:mwp_live_strength
                    subtract = var:mwp_own_maa
                    add = var:mwp_live_maa_before
                    subtract = var:mwp_live_knight_count
                    min = 0
                }
            }
            change_variable = {
                name = mwp_own_levy
                add = var:mwp_live_actor_levy
            }
            change_variable = {
                name = mwp_own_toughness
                add = {
                    value = var:mwp_live_actor_levy
                    divide = 100
                }
            }
            change_variable = {
                name = mwp_own_knight_damage
                add = {
                    value = var:mwp_live_knight_prowess
                    multiply = var:mwp_live_knight_effectiveness
                    multiply = 0.05
                }
            }
            change_variable = {
                name = mwp_own_knight_count
                add = var:mwp_live_knight_count
            }
            change_variable = {
                name = mwp_own_toughness
                add = {
                    value = var:mwp_live_knight_prowess
                    multiply = var:mwp_live_knight_effectiveness
                    divide = 100
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:mwp_live_side = 1
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_live_actor_levy
                value = {
                    value = var:mwp_live_strength
                    subtract = var:mwp_enemy_maa
                    add = var:mwp_live_maa_before
                    subtract = var:mwp_live_knight_count
                    min = 0
                }
            }
            change_variable = {
                name = mwp_enemy_levy
                add = var:mwp_live_actor_levy
            }
            change_variable = {
                name = mwp_enemy_toughness
                add = {
                    value = var:mwp_live_actor_levy
                    divide = 100
                }
            }
            change_variable = {
                name = mwp_enemy_knight_damage
                add = {
                    value = var:mwp_live_knight_prowess
                    multiply = var:mwp_live_knight_effectiveness
                    multiply = 0.05
                }
            }
            change_variable = {
                name = mwp_enemy_knight_count
                add = var:mwp_live_knight_count
            }
            change_variable = {
                name = mwp_enemy_toughness
                add = {
                    value = var:mwp_live_knight_prowess
                    multiply = var:mwp_live_knight_effectiveness
                    divide = 100
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable = mwp_live_initial
            }
            remove_variable = mwp_live_initial
            mwp_live_cache_player_effect = yes
            mwp_scoring_cached_profiles_effect = yes
        }
        else = {
            remove_list_variable = {
                name = mwp_live_own_queue
                target = var:mwp_live_character
            }
            remove_list_variable = {
                name = mwp_live_enemy_queue
                target = var:mwp_live_character
            }
            mwp_live_next_actor_effect = yes
        }
    }
}
mwp_live_next_scenario_effect = {
    remove_variable = mwp_live_next
    ordered_in_list = {
        variable = mwp_live_rivals_pending
        max = 1
        check_range_bounds = no
        limit = {
            is_alive = yes
        }
        save_scope_as = mwp_live_next_character
        scope:mwp_player = {
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_live_next
                value = scope:mwp_live_next_character
            }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = mwp_live_next
        }
        remove_list_variable = {
            name = mwp_live_rivals_pending
            target = var:mwp_live_next
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_live_rival
            value = var:mwp_live_next
        }
        mwp_live_restore_player_effect = yes
        mwp_scoring_reset_enemy_effect = yes
        mwp_live_prepare_coalition_effect = yes
        mwp_live_next_actor_effect = yes
    }
    else = {
        mwp_live_restore_player_effect = yes
        every_in_list = {
            variable = mwp_live_rivals_pending
            limit = {
                is_alive = no
            }
            scope:mwp_player = {
                change_variable = {
                    name = mwp_scoring_skipped_deceased_rivals
                    add = 1
                }
            }
        }
        clear_variable_list = mwp_live_rivals_pending
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_scoring_accounted_rivals
            value = {
                value = var:mwp_scoring_evaluated_rivals
                add = var:mwp_scoring_skipped_deceased_rivals
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:mwp_scoring_coverage_complete = yes
                var:mwp_scoring_evaluated_rivals > 0
                var:mwp_war_scoring_rival_count = var:mwp_scoring_accounted_rivals
            }
            mwp_scoring_publish_effect = yes
        }
        remove_variable = mwp_live_collecting
        remove_variable = mwp_live_stage
        remove_variable = mwp_scoring_active
    }
}
mwp_live_queue_own_ally_effect = {
    save_scope_as = mwp_live_ally
    scope:mwp_player = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = {
                    is_target_in_variable_list = {
                        name = mwp_live_own_queue
                        target = scope:mwp_live_ally
                    }
                }
                scope:mwp_live_ally != this
                scope:mwp_live_ally = {
                    is_alive = yes
                }
            }
            add_to_variable_list = {
                name = mwp_live_own_queue
                target = scope:mwp_live_ally
            }
        }
    }
}
mwp_live_queue_enemy_ally_effect = {
    save_scope_as = mwp_live_ally
    scope:mwp_player = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = {
                    is_target_in_variable_list = {
                        name = mwp_live_enemy_queue
                        target = scope:mwp_live_ally
                    }
                }
                scope:mwp_live_ally != this
                scope:mwp_live_ally = {
                    is_alive = yes
                }
            }
            add_to_variable_list = {
                name = mwp_live_enemy_queue
                target = scope:mwp_live_ally
            }
        }
    }
}
mwp_live_prepare_coalition_effect = {
    clear_variable_list = mwp_live_own_queue
    clear_variable_list = mwp_live_enemy_queue
    add_to_variable_list = {
        name = mwp_live_enemy_queue
        target = var:mwp_live_rival
    }
    remove_variable = mwp_live_active_coalition
    every_character_war = {
        limit = {
            is_participant = scope:mwp_player
            is_participant = scope:mwp_player.var:mwp_live_rival
            OR = {
                AND = {
                    is_attacker = scope:mwp_player
                    is_defender = scope:mwp_player.var:mwp_live_rival
                }
                AND = {
                    is_defender = scope:mwp_player
                    is_attacker = scope:mwp_player.var:mwp_live_rival
                }
            }
        }
        scope:mwp_player = {
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_live_active_coalition
                value = yes
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                is_attacker = scope:mwp_player
            }
            every_war_attacker = {
                mwp_live_queue_own_ally_effect = yes
            }
            every_war_defender = {
                mwp_live_queue_enemy_ally_effect = yes
            }
        }
        else = {
            every_war_defender = {
                mwp_live_queue_own_ally_effect = yes
            }
            every_war_attacker = {
                mwp_live_queue_enemy_ally_effect = yes
            }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_variable = mwp_live_active_coalition
            }
        }
        var:mwp_live_rival = {
            save_scope_as = mwp_live_rival_actor
            every_ally = {
                limit = {
                    is_alive = yes
                    this != scope:mwp_player
                    can_potentially_call_ally_trigger = {
                        JOINER = this
                        WARRIOR = scope:mwp_live_rival_actor
                    }
                }
                mwp_live_queue_enemy_ally_effect = yes
                scope:mwp_player = {
                    change_variable = {
                        name = mwp_scoring_possible_ally_count
                        add = 1
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = mwp_live_own_queue
            scope:mwp_player = {
                change_variable = {
                    name = mwp_scoring_actual_ally_count
                    add = 1
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
mwp_live_next_actor_effect = {
    remove_variable = mwp_live_next_actor
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_live_side
        value = 0
    }
    every_in_list = {
        variable = mwp_live_own_queue
        limit = {
            is_alive = yes
            scope:mwp_player = {
                NOT = {
                    has_variable = mwp_live_next_actor
                }
            }
        }
        save_scope_as = mwp_live_next_character
        scope:mwp_player = {
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_live_next_actor
                value = scope:mwp_live_next_character
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_live_side
                value = 0
            }
        }
    }
    every_in_list = {
        variable = mwp_live_enemy_queue
        limit = {
            is_alive = yes
            scope:mwp_player = {
                NOT = {
                    has_variable = mwp_live_next_actor
                }
            }
        }
        save_scope_as = mwp_live_next_character
        scope:mwp_player = {
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_live_next_actor
                value = scope:mwp_live_next_character
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_live_side
                value = 1
            }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = mwp_live_next_actor
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_live_character
            value = var:mwp_live_next_actor
        }
        mwp_live_load_actor_effect = yes
    }
    else = {
        every_in_list = {
            variable = mwp_live_own_queue
            limit = {
                is_alive = no
            }
            scope:mwp_player = {
                change_variable = {
                    name = mwp_scoring_skipped_deceased_actors
                    add = 1
                }
            }
        }
        every_in_list = {
            variable = mwp_live_enemy_queue
            limit = {
                is_alive = no
            }
            scope:mwp_player = {
                change_variable = {
                    name = mwp_scoring_skipped_deceased_actors
                    add = 1
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:mwp_live_rival = {
                    is_alive = yes
                }
            }
            mwp_scoring_evaluate_rival_snapshot_effect = yes
        }
        else = {
            change_variable = {
                name = mwp_scoring_skipped_deceased_rivals
                add = 1
            }
        }
        add_to_variable_list = {
            name = mwp_live_rivals_done
            target = var:mwp_live_rival
        }
        mwp_live_next_scenario_effect = yes
    }
}

            multiply = var:mwp_stack_$ID$
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            var:mwp_war_fort_weight_sum > 0
            var:mwp_siege_$ID$ > 0
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_metric_siege_$ID$
            value = {
                value = mwp_scoring_siege_gain_value
                multiply = var:mwp_siege_access
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:mwp_war_garrison_peak >= var:mwp_siege_next_troops
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_metric_siege_$ID$
                value = {
                    value = var:mwp_metric_siege_$ID$
                    multiply = 0.1
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            var:mwp_war_fort_weight_sum > 0
            var:mwp_war_garrison_peak >= var:mwp_siege_current_troops
            var:mwp_war_garrison_peak < var:mwp_siege_next_troops
        }
        change_variable = {
            name = mwp_metric_siege_$ID$
            add = {
                value = 100
                multiply = var:mwp_siege_access
            }
        }
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_score_$ID$
        value = {
            value = var:mwp_metric_field_$ID$
            add = var:mwp_metric_pursuit_$ID$
            add = var:mwp_metric_screen_$ID$
            add = var:mwp_metric_siege_$ID$
            min = 0
            add = 0.1
            add = {
                value = 0
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        var:mwp_damage_$ID$ > 0
                        var:mwp_toughness_$ID$ > 0
                    }
                    value = var:mwp_damage_$ID$
                    multiply = var:mwp_toughness_$ID$
                    pow = 0.5
                    multiply = var:mwp_stack_$ID$
                    divide = 20000
                }
            }
            divide = {
                value = var:mwp_metric_cost_$ID$
                min = 1
            }
            min = 0.001
        }
    }

            }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = mwp_assessed_110
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable = mwp_assessed_111
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        AND = {
                            NOT = {
                                has_variable = mwp_redundant_to_111
                            }
                            has_variable = mwp_redundant_to_110
                        }
                        AND = {
                            OR = {
                                AND = {
                                    has_variable = mwp_redundant_to_111
                                    has_variable = mwp_redundant_to_110
                                }
                                AND = {
                                    NOT = {
                                        has_variable = mwp_redundant_to_111
                                    }
                                    NOT = {
                                        has_variable = mwp_redundant_to_110
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            var:mwp_raw_assessed_score_111 > var:mwp_raw_assessed_score_110
                        }
                    }
                }
                change_variable = {
                    name = mwp_priority_110
                    add = 1
                }
            }
            else = {
                change_variable = {
                    name = mwp_priority_111
                    add = 1
                }
            }
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_rank_110
            value = 0
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_priority_center
            value = {
                value = var:mwp_priority_110
                multiply = 6
                subtract = 3
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    var:mwp_priority_count = 1
                    var:mwp_priority_center <= var:mwp_priority_green_bound
                }
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_rank_110
                value = 1
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                var:mwp_priority_center >= var:mwp_priority_red_bound
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_rank_110
                value = -1
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:mwp_priority_110 = 1
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_best_catalog_id
                value = 110
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_best_score
                value = var:mwp_assessed_score_110
            }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = mwp_assessed_111
        }

            value = 0
        }
        set_variable = {

                                    value = var:mwp_observed_damage
                                    min = 0
                                }
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                name = mwp_observed_toughness
                                value = {
                                    value = var:mwp_observed_toughness
                                    min = 0
                                }
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                name = mwp_observed_pursuit
                                value = {
                                    value = var:mwp_observed_pursuit
                                    min = 0
                                }
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                name = mwp_observed_screen
                                value = {
                                    value = var:mwp_observed_screen
                                    min = 0
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        else = {
                            set_variable = {
                                name = mwp_observed_damage
                                value = var:mwp_damage_111
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                name = mwp_observed_toughness
                                value = var:mwp_toughness_111
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                name = mwp_observed_pursuit
                                value = var:mwp_pursuit_111
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                name = mwp_observed_screen
                                value = var:mwp_screen_111
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                name = mwp_observed_siege
                                value = var:mwp_siege_111
                            }
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = mwp_planned_own_siege
                            add = {
                                value = scope:mwp_scoring_regiment_troops
                                multiply = var:mwp_observed_siege
                            }
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = mwp_planned_own_siege_tier4
                            add = {
                                value = scope:mwp_scoring_regiment_troops
                                multiply = var:mwp_observed_siege
                            }
                        }
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                var:mwp_planned_own_tier < 4
                            }
                            set_variable = {
                                name = mwp_planned_own_tier
                                value = 4
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    else = {
                        set_variable = {
                            name = mwp_scoring_coverage_complete
                            value = no
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = mwp_scoring_unknown_regiments
                            add = 1
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            else = {
                scope:mwp_player = {
                    set_variable = {
                        name = mwp_scoring_coverage_complete
                        value = no
                    }
                    change_variable = {
                        name = mwp_scoring_unknown_regiments
                        add = 1
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        else = {
            scope:mwp_player = {
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_scoring_coverage_complete
                    value = no
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

mwp_dev11_redundancy_effect = {
    remove_variable = mwp_siege_representative_id
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_siege_representative_score
        value = 0
    }
    remove_variable = mwp_redundant_to_1
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_redundancy_factor_1
        value = 1
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = mwp_assessed_1
            var:mwp_assessed_metric_cost_1 > 0
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_raw_assessed_score_1
            value = var:mwp_assessed_score_1
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_role_quality_1
            value = 0
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_role_damage_1
            value = {
                value = var:mwp_assessed_damage_1
                multiply = var:mwp_assessed_stack_1
                divide = var:mwp_assessed_metric_cost_1
            }
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_role_toughness_1
            value = {

mwp_dev11_refresh_siege_priorities_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = mwp_batch_continue
            has_variable = mwp_auto_last_paid_verified

            var:mwp_script_selected_action = 2
            OR = {
                var:mwp_script_selected_id = 49

                var:mwp_script_selected_id = 54

                var:mwp_script_selected_id = 111
            }
            exists = scope:mwp_batch_max_before
        }
        remove_variable = mwp_d11_paid_siege_slot
        var:mwp_script_selected_regiment = {
            save_scope_value_as = {
                name = mwp_d11_added_capacity
                value = {
                    value = maa_max_troops_count
                    subtract = scope:mwp_batch_max_before
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable = mwp_extra_1001
                has_variable = mwp_extra_regiment_1001
                var:mwp_extra_regiment_1001 = var:mwp_script_selected_regiment
                NOT = {
                    has_variable = mwp_d11_paid_siege_slot
                }
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_d11_paid_siege_slot
                value = 1001
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_d11_paid_siege_tier
                value = var:mwp_extra_tier_1001
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = mwp_d11_added_siege

            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_variable = mwp_d11_saved_mwp_script_selected_upkeep
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_script_selected_upkeep
                    value = var:mwp_d11_saved_mwp_script_selected_upkeep
                }
            }
            remove_variable = mwp_d11_saved_mwp_script_selected_upkeep
            remove_variable = mwp_script_selected_action
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_variable = mwp_d11_saved_mwp_script_selected_action
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_script_selected_action
                    value = var:mwp_d11_saved_mwp_script_selected_action
                }
            }
            remove_variable = mwp_d11_saved_mwp_script_selected_action
            remove_variable = mwp_script_has_candidate
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_variable = mwp_d11_saved_mwp_script_has_candidate
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_script_has_candidate
                    value = var:mwp_d11_saved_mwp_script_has_candidate
                }
            }
            remove_variable = mwp_d11_saved_mwp_script_has_candidate
            remove_variable = mwp_script_has_gold
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_variable = mwp_d11_saved_mwp_script_has_gold
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_script_has_gold
                    value = var:mwp_d11_saved_mwp_script_has_gold
                }
            }
            remove_variable = mwp_d11_saved_mwp_script_has_gold
            remove_variable = mwp_next_catalog_id
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_variable = mwp_d11_saved_mwp_next_catalog_id
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_next_catalog_id
                    value = var:mwp_d11_saved_mwp_next_catalog_id
                }
            }
            remove_variable = mwp_d11_saved_mwp_next_catalog_id
            remove_variable = mwp_next_price
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_variable = mwp_d11_saved_mwp_next_price
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = mwp_next_price
                    value = var:mwp_d11_saved_mwp_next_price
                }

            remove_variable = mwp_d11_saved_mwp_next_price

                    value = var:mwp_d11_saved_mwp_next_action
                }
            }
            remove_variable = mwp_d11_saved_mwp_next_action
        }
        else = {
            remove_variable = mwp_batch_continue
        }
    }

mwp_bridge_skip_candidate_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = mwp_scoring_active
            var:mwp_scoring_active = yes
            has_variable = mwp_scoring_schema
            var:mwp_scoring_schema = 2
            has_variable = mwp_scoring_owner
            var:mwp_scoring_owner = this
            has_variable = mwp_generation
            has_variable = mwp_scoring_generation
            var:mwp_scoring_generation = var:mwp_generation
            exists = scope:mwp_candidate_owner
            scope:mwp_candidate_owner = this
            exists = scope:mwp_candidate_generation
            scope:mwp_candidate_generation = var:mwp_generation
            exists = scope:mwp_candidate_catalog_id
            has_variable = mwp_bridge_mask_owner
            var:mwp_bridge_mask_owner = this
            has_variable = mwp_bridge_mask_generation
            var:mwp_bridge_mask_generation = var:mwp_generation
        }
        save_scope_as = mwp_player
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:mwp_candidate_catalog_id = 1
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = {
                        has_variable = mwp_seen_1
                    }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            AND = {
                                var:mwp_metric_cost_1 > 0
                                OR = {
                                    can_create_maa = huscarl
                                    any_maa_regiment = {
                                        is_maa_type = huscarl
                                        is_personal_maa_regiment = yes
                                        is_regular_maa_regiment = yes
                                        can_upgrade_maa = yes
                                    }
                                    any_maa_regiment = {
                                        is_maa_type = huscarl
                                        is_personal_maa_regiment = yes
                                        is_regular_maa_regiment = yes
                                        regiment_owner = scope:mwp_player
                                    }
                                    mwp_type_unlocked_1_trigger = yes
                                    any_held_title = {
                                        holder = scope:mwp_player
                                        OR = {
                                            can_create_title_maa = huscarl
                                            any_owned_title_maa_regiment = {
                                                is_maa_type = huscarl
                                                is_regular_maa_regiment = yes
                                                is_title_maa_regiment = yes
                                                regiment_owner = scope:mwp_player
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            any_maa_regiment = {
                                is_maa_type = huscarl
                                OR = {
                                    maa_current_troops_count > 0
                                    AND = {
                                        is_personal_maa_regiment = yes
                                        is_regular_maa_regiment = yes
                                        maa_size > 0
                                        maa_max_troops_count > 0
                                        regiment_owner = scope:mwp_player
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            any_army = {
                                any_army_maa_regiment = {
                                    is_maa_type = huscarl
                                    OR = {
                                        maa_current_troops_count > 0
                                        AND = {
                                            is_personal_maa_regiment = yes
                                            is_regular_maa_regiment = yes
                                            maa_size > 0
                                            maa_max_troops_count > 0
                                            regiment_owner = scope:mwp_player
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        name = mwp_bridge_needed_1
                        value = yes
                    }
                }
                else = {
