# DEV12: current-actor census only. Identity and count are exact; level/capacity
# totals detect ordinary resize, not offsetting per-regiment geometry changes.
mwp_live_check_inventory_regiment_effect = {
    save_scope_as = mwp_inventory_regiment
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                maa_current_troops_count > 0
                AND = {
                    is_personal_maa_regiment = yes
                    is_regular_maa_regiment = yes
                    maa_size > 0
                    maa_max_troops_count > 0
                    regiment_owner = scope:mwp_player
                }
            }
        }
        scope:mwp_player = {
            if = { limit = {
                NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = mwp_inventory_regiments target = scope:mwp_inventory_regiment } }
            }
                add_to_variable_list = { name = mwp_inventory_regiments target = scope:mwp_inventory_regiment }
                change_variable = { name = mwp_inventory_count add = 1 }
                scope:mwp_inventory_regiment = {
                    save_scope_value_as = { name = mwp_inventory_levels value = maa_size }
                    save_scope_value_as = { name = mwp_inventory_capacity value = maa_max_troops_count }
                }
                change_variable = { name = mwp_inventory_levels add = scope:mwp_inventory_levels }
                change_variable = { name = mwp_inventory_capacity add = scope:mwp_inventory_capacity }
                if = { limit = {
                    NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = mwp_live_regiments target = scope:mwp_inventory_regiment } }
                } set_variable = { name = mwp_inventory_changed value = yes } }
            }
        }
    }
}

mwp_live_verify_inventory_effect = {
    # Recheck at mutation time; delayed callbacks cannot reset another actor,
    # owner, epoch or generation. This never acknowledges a missing regiment.
    if = { limit = {
is_ai = no
is_alive = yes
exists = scope:mwp_candidate_owner
scope:mwp_candidate_owner = this
exists = scope:mwp_candidate_generation
has_variable = mwp_generation
scope:mwp_candidate_generation = var:mwp_generation
has_variable = mwp_scoring_active
var:mwp_scoring_active = yes
has_variable = mwp_scoring_schema
var:mwp_scoring_schema = 2
has_variable = mwp_scoring_owner
var:mwp_scoring_owner = this
has_variable = mwp_scoring_generation
var:mwp_scoring_generation = var:mwp_generation
var:mwp_scoring_seen_count = 111
has_variable = mwp_live_collecting
var:mwp_live_collecting = yes
has_variable = mwp_live_stage
var:mwp_live_stage = 1
exists = scope:mwp_live_actor
has_variable = mwp_live_character
scope:mwp_live_actor = var:mwp_live_character
exists = scope:mwp_live_epoch
has_variable = mwp_live_epoch
scope:mwp_live_epoch = var:mwp_live_epoch
    }
        save_scope_as = mwp_player
        clear_variable_list = mwp_inventory_regiments
        remove_variable = mwp_inventory_changed
        set_variable = { name = mwp_inventory_count value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = mwp_inventory_levels value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = mwp_inventory_capacity value = 0 }
        scope:mwp_live_actor = {
            every_maa_regiment = { mwp_live_check_inventory_regiment_effect = yes }
        every_held_title = { every_controlled_title_maa_regiment = { mwp_live_check_inventory_regiment_effect = yes } }
            every_army = { every_army_maa_regiment = { mwp_live_check_inventory_regiment_effect = yes } }
        }
        if = { limit = { OR = {
            NOT = { var:mwp_inventory_count = var:mwp_live_expected }
            NOT = { has_variable = mwp_live_expected_levels }
            NOT = { has_variable = mwp_live_expected_capacity }
            NOT = { var:mwp_inventory_levels = var:mwp_live_expected_levels }
            NOT = { var:mwp_inventory_capacity = var:mwp_live_expected_capacity }
        } } set_variable = { name = mwp_inventory_changed value = yes } }
        clear_variable_list = mwp_inventory_regiments
        if = { limit = { has_variable = mwp_inventory_changed }
            # Fence all old callbacks before issuing the next request. Original
            # finish predicates are rechecked after this effect returns.
            remove_variable = mwp_scoring_active
            remove_variable = mwp_live_collecting
            remove_variable = mwp_live_stage
            if = { limit = { var:mwp_live_side = 0 }
                mwp_request_own_analysis_effect = yes
            }
            else = { mwp_request_analysis_effect = yes }
        }
        remove_variable = mwp_inventory_changed
    }
}

                        var:mwp_d13_candidate_toughness > 0

                    multiply = var:mwp_d13_candidate_toughness

                divide = {
                    value = var:mwp_war_terrain_weight_sum

mwp_d13_candidate_coverage_effect = {
    set_variable = {
        name = mwp_d13_candidate_factor
        value = 1
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = mwp_d13_power_mean_$ID$
            var:mwp_d13_power_mean_$ID$ > 0
            var:mwp_d13_weight_sum > 0
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = mwp_d13_candidate_factor
            value = 0
        }
        change_variable = {
            name = mwp_d13_candidate_factor
            add = {
                value = var:mwp_d13_power_$ID$_desert

mwp_d13_add_terrain_capacity_effect = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = mwp_extra_$SLOT$
            $TROOPS$ > 0
            $BEFORE$ >= 0
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:mwp_extra_$SLOT$ = 1
            }
            change_variable = {
                name = mwp_d13_own_damage_desert
                add = {
                    value = $BEFORE$
                    add = $TROOPS$
                    multiply = {
                        value = var:mwp_d13_native_damage_$SLOT$
                        add = 0
                        min = 0
                    }
                    divide = 1000
                    subtract = {
                        value = $BEFORE$
                        multiply = {
                            value = var:mwp_d13_native_damage_$SLOT$
                            add = 0
                            min = 0
                        }
                        divide = 1000
                    }
                }
            }
            change_variable = {
                name = mwp_d13_own_toughness_desert
                add = {
                    value = $BEFORE$
                    add = $TROOPS$
                    multiply = {
                        value = var:mwp_d13_native_toughness_$SLOT$
                        add = 0
                        min = 0
                    }
                    divide = 1000
                    subtract = {
                        value = $BEFORE$
                        multiply = {
                            value = var:mwp_d13_native_toughness_$SLOT$
                            add = 0
                            min = 0
                        }
                        divide = 1000
                    }
                }

mwp_d14_collect_paid_siege_effect = {
if = { limit = {
exists = scope:mwp_player
scope:mwp_player = { has_variable = mwp_live_collecting }
exists = scope:mwp_live_siege
scope:mwp_live_siege > 0
is_personal_maa_regiment = yes is_regular_maa_regiment = yes is_title_maa_regiment = no
regiment_owner = scope:mwp_player maa_size > 0 maa_max_troops_count > 0
OR = {
    is_maa_type = onager
    is_maa_type = mangonel
    is_maa_type = trebuchet
    is_maa_type = bombard
    is_maa_type = torch_bearers
    is_maa_type = ballista
    is_maa_type = cloud_ladder
    is_maa_type = siege_tower
    is_maa_type = cannon
}

}
save_scope_as = mwp_d14_paid_siege
scope:mwp_player = { add_to_variable_list = { name = mwp_d14_paid_siege_regiments target = scope:mwp_d14_paid_siege } }
}

mwp_d14_siege_census_effect = {
save_scope_as = mwp_d14_role_owner
set_variable = { name = mwp_d14_useful_siege_count value = 0 }
remove_variable = mwp_d14_last_useful_siege
if = { limit = { has_variable = mwp_d14_siege_observed
var:mwp_d14_siege_observed = yes has_variable_list = mwp_d14_paid_siege_regiments }
every_in_list = { variable = mwp_d14_paid_siege_regiments limit = { is_personal_maa_regiment = yes
is_regular_maa_regiment = yes
is_title_maa_regiment = no
regiment_owner = scope:mwp_d14_role_owner
maa_size > 0
maa_max_troops_count > 0 }
save_scope_as = mwp_d14_live_siege
scope:mwp_d14_role_owner = {
change_variable = { name = mwp_d14_useful_siege_count add = 1 }
set_variable = { name = mwp_d14_last_useful_siege value = scope:mwp_d14_live_siege }
}
}
}

# One automatic full rebuild for an expired cache, never an immediate recursive scan.
mwp_d18_recover_expired_cache_effect = {
 if = { limit = {
    NOT = { mwp_auto_fresh_trigger = yes }
    has_variable = mwp_generation
    has_variable = mwp_scoring_owner var:mwp_scoring_owner = this
    has_variable = mwp_scoring_generation var:mwp_scoring_generation = var:mwp_generation
    has_variable = mwp_enemy_cache_owner var:mwp_enemy_cache_owner = this
    has_variable = mwp_enemy_cache_day
    days_since_birth >= mwp_enemy_cache_expiry_day_value
 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = mwp_d18_expiry_rebuild_generation }
        if = { limit = { var:mwp_d18_expiry_rebuild_generation != var:mwp_generation } mwp_request_analysis_effect = yes
set_variable = { name = mwp_d18_expiry_rebuild_generation value = var:mwp_generation } }
    }
    else = { mwp_request_analysis_effect = yes
set_variable = { name = mwp_d18_expiry_rebuild_generation value = var:mwp_generation } }
 }
}
